newsitem.title: USA: Bay View Capital boosts qtly div to $0.16.
newsitem.headline: Bay View Capital boosts qtly div to $0.16.

text.p: Bay View Capital Corp said Tuesday its board of directors had approved an increase of 6.7 percent in its regular quarterly cash dividend from $0.15 per share to $0.16 per share, its first increase since the company began paying dividends in 1989.
The company said the dividend was payable January 24, 1997 to shareholders of record as of January 10, 1997.
Bay View Capital Corp is the holding company for Bay View Federal Bank and California Thrift & Loan.
Bay View Federal Bank operates 26 full service community banking centers throughout the San Francisco Bay Area.
